(331)༄༅/ /ni gu'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ/gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'a

tei:div.tei:p: ni gu'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ /gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rin po che// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la=== /gnas seng ldeng 'khrigs pa'i nags khrod du// ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu la=== /gnas zhang zhong dpal gyi dgon pa ru// mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la=== /shangs lha phu rmog cog gi dgon pa ru// mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus la=== /dbus stod lung skyer sgang gi dgon pa ru// dbon ston thugs rje chen po la=== /gnas yol phu ri gong gi dgon pa ru// gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la=== /gnas yol phu brag rtsa'i dgon pa ru// chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa la=== /gnas 'jag chung dpal gyi dgon pa ru// mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston la=== /mus mtha' gong dpal gyi ra ba ru// mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la=== /gnas gnyan khrod brgya rtsa'i dben gnas su// bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la=== /mus rdzi lung dpal gyi dgon pa ru// mtshan ldan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la=== /byang rdo rje gdan gyi dgon pa ru// byang sems sbyin pa bzang po la=== /dpal ri bo che yi rtse mo ru// grub chen thang stong rgyal po la=== /gnas mang mkhar dgon gsar gyi dgon pa ru// brgyud 'dzin blo gros rgyal mtshan la=== /gnas pu rong dben pa'i nags khrod du// mkhas grub dpal ldan dar po la=== /gnas zhe dgon dpal gyi dur khrod du// rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo la=== /gnas grub ri e waṃ dga' 'khyil du// bskal bzang 'gyur med bde chen la=== /gnas bla brang rdzong gi bzhugs gnas su// mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags la=== /gnas dge 'phel chos kyi pho brang du// 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan la===

/gnas gsang sngags bde chen dben pa ru// ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas (332)la=== /gnas spro mo lung gi dben pa ru// mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel la=== /gnas bkra shis chos kyi sde chen du// kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas la=== /mdog zhe dgon rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu// 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dpal bzang la=== /gnas bsam rdzong chos sde'i pho brang du// 'phags mchog chos nyid ye shes la=== /mus grub pa mchog gi sman ljongs su// mtshungs med ye shes rgyal mchog la=== /dpal sa skya'i chos gra chen po ru// yongs 'dzin ma ti'i mtshan can la=== /gnas bya 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du// 'jam mgon badzra ratna la=== /gnas ris med mkhas grub tshogs dbus su// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la=== /gnas snying ga chos kyi pho brang du// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la=== /gnas rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs la=== /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu// chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la=== /gnas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du// myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la=== /sems dag pa'i 'dun sa nges med du// mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs la gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rin po che// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar du byin gyis rlobs// sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol du=== /rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag tu=== /'od gsal gti mug rang sangs su=== /'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas su byin gyis rlobs// bar do rgyal ba longs sku ru byin gyis rlobs// 'od gsal phyag chen rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/// /
